summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing a board meeting scheduled for August 18, 2026 (Beijing time) to approve its unaudited Q2 2026 financial results, interim results, and potential dividend declaration. The filing also includes details for an earnings conference call on August 19, 2026. This is a routine earnings announcement and board meeting notice, not a special situation event. No deal terms, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring are indicated. The filing is purely informational for investors.
